name: trl-to-pgn
description: Comprehensive toolkit for converting between Ludii trial files (.trl) and Portable Game Notation (PGN) files for chess games

scripts.roundtrip:all-trl: bash -lc 'for f in $(ls *.trl examples/*.trl 2>/dev/null | grep -Ev "(_rt|_backup)\.trl$|(_rt|_backup)_[^/]*\.trl$"); do [ -f "$f" ] && bash tools/roundtrip_trl.sh -f "$f"; done'
scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:semantic
scripts.validate:examples: bash -lc "for f in examples/*.{pgn,trl}; do if [ -f \"$f\" ]; then echo \"Validating $f\"; node dist/tools/validate_pgn.js \"$f\" || true; fi; done"
scripts.web:build: npm run build && npm run web:vendor && bash -lc 'mkdir -p web/dist && cp -f dist/*.js web/dist/ && cp -f dist/src/*.js web/dist/ || true'
scripts.pages:prepare: npm run web:build && bash -lc 'rm -rf docs && mkdir -p docs && touch docs/.nojekyll && cp -R web/* docs/'
scripts.web:vendor: bash -lc 'mkdir -p web/vendor/stockfish && (cp -f node_modules/stockfish/stockfish*.js web/vendor/stockfish/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp -f node_modules/stockfish/**/*.js web/vendor/stockfish/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp -f node_modules/stockfish/**/*.wasm web/vendor/stockfish/ 2>/dev/null || true)'
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist/ *.csv node_modules/.cache temp/ .temp/ *.log *.diff debug_output*.txt comparison_report*.csv semantic_report*.csv differences_summary.txt orig_setscores.txt ref_setscores.txt test_*.pgn test_*.trl examples/*_rt.* examples/*_rt_*.* examples/*_roundtrip.* examples/*_rt_roundtrip.* examples/*_rt_rt.*
